title: Measuring Pretraining Contamination in Public Medical Vision-Language Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2606.10066v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) are evaluated on public benchmarks whose images and question-answer pairs have been freely available for years, yet reported accuracy assumes that these examples were not in the training data. We test this assumption for open VLMs on SLAKE-En, PathVQA, and VQA-RAD, and on a public mirror of OmniMedVQA, using four detectors: image near-neighbour search against PMC-OA-beta, canonical-order exchangeability, cohort-relative Min-K%++ tail enrichment, and cross-model top-K overlap. On the image side, 19.8% of SLAKE-En images have an unusually close neighbour in PMC-OA-beta under SigLIP-B-16 (4.2% under SigLIP-SO400M), while out-of-domain control images produce no flags. Manual inspection shows that these are images of the same modality and view from different patients, not exact copies, so we read the signal as overlap in image sources rather than memorization of individual images. translated_title: 衡量公开医学视觉-语言基准中的预训练数据污染
translated_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型在公开基准上进行评估，而这些基准的图像和问答对已免费公开多年，但报告的准确率默认这些样本未出现在训练数据中。我们在SLAKE-En、PathVQA、VQA-RAD以及OmniMedVQA的公开镜像上，使用四种检测方法（针对PMC-OA-beta的图像近邻搜索、规范顺序可交换性、队列相对Min-K%++尾部富集、跨模型top-K重叠度）对开源VLM检验了这一假设。在图像方面，在SigLIP-B-16下，SLAKE-En中19.8%的图像在PMC-OA-beta中存在异常接近的近邻（SigLIP-SO400M下为4.2%），而域外对照图像未产生任何标记。人工检查显示这些是来自不同患者但具有相同模态和视角的图像，并非完全相同的副本，因此我们将这一信号解读为图像来源的重叠，而非对单个图像的记忆。在文本方面……
tldr: 该研究使用四种检测方法系统评估公开医学视觉-语言基准的预训练数据污染，发现图像层面的重叠信号主要反映图像来源的重叠而非模型对个体图像的记忆。
en_tdlr: This study applies four detectors to measure pretraining contamination in public medical vision-language benchmarks, finding that image-side overlap signals reflect shared image sources rather than memorization of individual images.
